description: This file defines an enumeration 'OutputFormat' with two cases ('txt' and 'srt') that specify different output formats for text processing, including methods to format transcript text and handle time ranges specific to subtitle formatting.

methods.name: needsAudioTimeRange
methods.description: A property that indicates whether the output format requires audio time ranges; true only for 'srt' format.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Generates formatted text based on the specified output format ('txt' or 'srt') from an attributed transcript, including time range formatting for subtitles.
